newsitem.title: USA: CME Pork bellies rally back sharply for net gains.
newsitem.headline: CME Pork bellies rally back sharply for net gains.

text.p: CME pork belly futures rallied back sharply for net gains as short covering developed on an oversold condition, traders said.

Bellies ran up to post gains of 0.950 to 1.200 cents per lb in nearbys before encountering fresh selling interest and again turning lower. The wide price swings, down as much as 2.125 cent lower shortly after the start, to the net gain and back down again will likely continue at these high price levels, traders said.
